notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.4.016.470
notes.content:
Hi all, very quick patch addressing the following issue:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug causing Checkpoints to not save correctly
[/list]
If you have any more feedback or encounter any other issues, please reach out to us in the forums or at support@thebinarymill.com

Thank you all for you continued support!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.4.016.468
notes.content:
Thank you all for the amazing support since launch! We've been keeping a close eye on things and this update brings a few fixes and improvements based on your feedback:

[list]
[*]Added a confirmation dialogue when changing Render Scale
[*]Fixed an issue with audio stuttering and cutting out, especially in longer or twistier caves
[*]Fixed an issue causing invisible resource patches in caves
[*]A few other minor optimizations and fixes
[/list]

If you have any more feedback or encounter any other issues, please reach out to us in the forums or at support@thebinarymill.com

Happy mining!

notes.title: Into Black is NOW LIVE on SteamVR!
notes.content:
[p]We’re beyond excited to welcome players into the shadows and can’t wait to see you mining, crafting, surviving, and discovering together.[/p][p]To celebrate launch day, we’ve also released a brand-new Accolades Trailer, showcasing some of the amazing early praise the game has already received from critics and creators.[/p][previewyoutube="CETHGA_UR9o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Whether you’re descending solo or diving in with friends in 4-player co-op, this is just the beginning of your journey Into Black.[/p][p]Thank you all for the incredible support - and we’ll see you in the dark![/p][p]- The Binary Mill Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Into Black releases August 28th!
notes.content:
[p][b]📢 Exciting News![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Into Black[/i] will launch on [b]SteamVR[/b] on [b]August 28, 2025[/b]![/p][p]Mark your calendars and get ready to step into the shadows - and into the light - in our atmospheric action-adventure built for VR.[/p][p]🗓 [b]Release Date:[/b] August 28, 2025
🕶 [b]Platforms:[/b] SteamVR + PlayStation VR2 (day-and-date)[/p][p]Alongside this announcement, we’re excited to share a brand-new trailer showcasing the updated graphics and immersive enhancements in [i]Into Black[/i]. Experience the game’s refined visual fidelity, dynamic shadows, and atmospheric details that deepen the tension and mystery as you navigate its shadowy world. This trailer offers a fresh glimpse into the action-packed journey awaiting players on launch day.[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to experience the world of [i]Into Black[/i]. Stay tuned here for more updates as we get closer to launch![/p][previewyoutube="bqC78bALt7E;full"][/previewyoutube]
